pairs.subject: native-shell-integration
pairs.evidence: apps/console/package.json:24 The console's only native runtime dependency is the URL opener, and the shell and router run entirely in the document (hash routing, a window keydown keymap); searching shell/, router/ and package.json found no global-shortcut, always-on-top, cursor-ignore, input-synthesis or stream-ownership code, so this context holds none of the capabilities the subject is about (it falls under app-shell instead).

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/shell/Shell.tsx:83 Keys come from the document's own keydown on window; no native wrapper forwards hardware or remote keys into the page.
apps/console/src/shell/keyActions.ts:7 Key chords are read inside the console's own document; nothing synthesizes input into a foreign application.
apps/console/src/router/store.ts:61 The router subscribes only to in-document hashchange; the context owns no long-lived network stream.
apps/console/package.json:24 No shell or router feature depends on a capability that some host lacks.
